Company/Product:

FORJE Academy: Mobile-first LMS for Nigerian retail sales staff, 20–250+ learners, ≤$60/month, non-technical admin.

Brand: Premium but accessible; navy #002147, gold #f3e88e; Netflix-simple, modern cards, not corporate.

Market: Nigeria (97.7% mobile internet, Android-dominant, expensive/patchy data, 2G/3G/4G mix, frequent offline usage).

Audience: Retail store staff (18–35, visual learners, limited data, not techie), managers (want instant stats and compliance), non-technical admin (runs everything via Google Sheets).

Business Model: Cohort license per learner; partners include Lagos Business School, Adidas.

Stack & Tech:

Stack: Telegram bot (python-telegram-bot, DMs, reminders, leaderboards), Static HTML/PWA (GitHub Pages or Netlify), Google Sheets backend, Apps Script (JSON endpoints, grading, progress/achievements), OpenAI Whisper+GPT for voice grading, YouTube video embeds, ≤60s voice reflections.

Offline: PWA service workers cache modules, 80–90% data savings, background sync, full functionality on poor/patchy connections.

Maintenance: Google Sheets for all content; no server admin; updates in Sheets go live instantly.

Scalability: Google Sheets to 2,000+ learners, Telegram bots handle 100,000+, 20% monthly growth fully supported for 2 years.
